name: Trend with a volatility-risk-premium filter
description: QR-10 (W30). Medium-term trend entries (close above the 50-session average, positive 60-session return) taken only while the options market is calm: the volatility risk premium is non-negative (implied >= realised) and ATM IV rank is below the parameter. Exits when the trend breaks, or when realised volatility overtakes implied (negative VRP -- stress) or IV rank spikes. F&O stocks only.

parameters.name: max_iv_rank
parameters.description: Entry only while ATM IV rank is at most

parameters.name: min_vrp
parameters.description: Entry only while IV - RV20 (vol points) is at least

parameters.name: exit_vrp
parameters.description: Exit when IV - RV20 falls below
